metadata.reference_strategy: TOP signal, INNER1 copper window, INNER2 continuous L3 reference
notes: Use this policy to draw only the generated Marki 5th-order filter elements and the materialized INNER1 ground pieces.
Existing BFP_5O feed/core/TOP ground and via-fence objects are supplied as explicit delete names to the replacement tool.
The INNER1 cutout is represented by generated ground-plane pieces, not by a candidate-level boolean operation.
